Name: Lavender Tea Farm - New Farm Map
Author: violetskye5
Description:
[b]Description:[/b]
A new farm type with more buildings, machines, and animals.

[b]Installation Instructions:[/b]
Download the mod via a mod manager for automatic installation or download manually, ensure the compressed file is placed within the Stardew Valley\mods folder, extract all from the compressed file in the same location. Both files must be downloaded and installed for it to work. You need to start a new farm after downloading for the farm to work, it will not add buildings in the right place if you add it to another save.

[b]Main Features:[/b]
[list]
[*]barn with 2 sheep[/*]
[*]extra chest in barn with a keg, a loop, 3 garden pots, and 5 bee houses[/*]
[*]6 re-growable stumps[/*]
[*]forest fish are catchable on farm[/*]
[*]silo with 20 pieces of hay[/*]
[/list]
[b]Other Notes:[/b]
[list]
[*]replaces the standard farm[/*]
[*]there are no starter cabins locations[/*]
[*]made with help from LeeloMods[/*]
[/list]
[b]Possible Problems:[/b]
[list]
[*]missing barn and silo - missing building file (TessFarm) - good if you like the layout but don't want extra buildings[/*]
[*]missing farm layout/map - missing map file (TessFarmContentPack)[/*]
[/list][b]Compatibility:[/b]
[list]
[*]works with DaisyNiko's Earthy Recolor - go into the tessfarmcontentpack, open assets folder, delete all tilesheets (leave "Farm_Tess" and "icon" those are the only two things you need in the recolor)[/*]
[/list]

Downloads.Description: This is the extra things, this lets you have the barn, silo, and chest in the barn. This is optional, if you don't want to start with the extra buildings and chest and you just want the map as normal, you don't have to download this for the map to work.
This is just the map. If you want the barn, silo, and chest of stuff, you will need both files.
